text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Riding high on the momentum from her 
sightseeing trip, Mejiro Palmer put on a 
magnificent performance in the Hakodate 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she still doesn't know what she 
truly wants to do from the bottom of her 
heart. In order to find out—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding to revisit her home turf of 
Hokkaido over the summer, she plans to 
investigate while having a blast. Her next 
target is set for next year's Nikkei 
Shinshun Hai.
